requirements.businessContext: The Gameweeks & Fixtures module owns the lifecycle of the 38-GW season skeleton and the round-robin fixture pipeline that pairs teams for every league-stage GW. Admins seed GW1-38 from live FPL bootstrap deadlines, generate fixtures sized to their format (TVT 8/16/32-team using `(playoffStartGw-1)/(teamsPerGroup-1)` repetitions; JPL Continental Championship PL = 20 teams x 2 reps = 38 GWs), optionally override fixtures via CSV/XLSX bulk upload, and then run per-GW processing that calculates TVT match scores, chips, and bonus points. A superadmin process-all orchestrator (plan -> per-league-GW -> finish) catches up scoring across every active league with FPL-finalized gameweeks, while public visitors can read fixture lists and live scores.

businessRules.rule: POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/create-gameweeks requires admin/superadmin session resolved via getAuthorizedLeagueId; an unauthorized caller returns HTTP 403 with `{ error: 'Forbidden' }`.

create-gameweeks fetches `https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/bootstrap-static/` with `cache: 'no-store'`; any non-OK response surfaces HTTP 502 with `{ error: 'Failed to fetch FPL gameweek data' }`, and an empty `events` array surfaces HTTP 502 with `{ error: 'No FPL events found' }`.
Only FPL events with `id` in the inclusive range 1..38 are eligible for gameweek creation; out-of-range events are silently skipped.
Any GW number that already exists for the league increments the `skipped` counter without re-inserting; the response always reports both `created` and `skipped` counts.

New gameweek rows are inserted with `isPlayoffs: false` and `deadline` derived from FPL `event.deadline_time` parsed as a Date; the `gameweeks_league_number_unique` composite index on (leagueId, number) enforces one row per (league, gw) pair at the DB layer.
create-gameweeks is on the expensive-route bucket: a per-admin 30 POSTs/min rate limit (keyed by session ID) applies; exceeding it returns HTTP 429.
POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-fixtures requires admin/superadmin via getAuthorizedLeagueId; missing league config returns HTTP 404 `League not found`.

generate-fixtures refuses to run if any fixture already exists for the league; the response is HTTP 400 with message `Fixtures have already been generated for this league. Delete existing fixtures first.`
League format dispatch: `format === 'continental-championship'` runs the JPL Continental Championship PL path (38 GWs, 2 reps, single PL group); all other formats use the TVT path.
JPL Continental Championship PL path uses Group A teams when Group A exists and has >=2 teams; otherwise it falls back to fetching every team in the league (groupless leagues supported).

JPL Continental Championship POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-fixtures asserts plTeams.length === 20 before generating fixtures. Any other count returns HTTP 400 with body { error: 'Continental Championship requires exactly 20 PL teams; this league has N.' } and no insert runs. The 2-repetition math (20 teams × 2 = 38 GWs) only holds for exactly 20 teams.
JPL Continental Championship path inserts any missing GW 1-38 with `isPlayoffs: false` and `deadline: new Date()` (current time) when not previously created via FPL bootstrap.
JPL Continental Championship fixtures are tagged with `competitionType: 'pl'` and inherit the Group A `groupId` when present; null otherwise.

TVT single-group format (`groupCount === 1`, i.e. 8 or 16-team leagues): use Group A if it has >=2 teams; otherwise fall back to all league teams. <2 teams returns HTTP 400 with `League must have at least 2 teams (has N)`.
TVT two-group format (32-team) requires Group A and Group B records to exist and each to contain >=2 teams; missing records or under-filled groups return HTTP 400 with specific error messages.

TVT repetitions are computed by formula `(playoffStartGw - 1) / (teamsPerGroup - 1)` where `teamsPerGroup = teamSize / groupCount`; effectivePlayoffStart defaults to 31 if null. 32-team: 30/15=2 reps; 16-team: 30/15=2 reps; 8-team: 35/7=5 reps.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-fixtures requires real FPL gameweek deadlines to exist before fixtures are generated. The TVT branch refuses with HTTP 400 if no league-stage gameweeks exist; the JPL Continental Championship branch refuses if any of GW1..38 is missing (with the missingGameweeks list in the response). Placeholder `new Date()` deadlines are no longer created — admins must call POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/create-gameweeks first (which fetches real deadlines from the FPL bootstrap).

Round-robin generator: appends a `BYE` placeholder for odd team counts, runs `repetitions` full passes, alternates home/away on odd-indexed repetitions, and skips matches involving the BYE so each round has fewer than `n/2` fixtures.
Each TVT fixture row carries `groupId` (Group A or Group B id) so bonus calculation and standings can scope per-group; missing groupId disables bonus eligibility for that fixture.

GET /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-fixtures returns `{ fixturesGenerated, totalFixtures, leagueConfig, groups, readyToGenerate }`; `readyToGenerate` requires Group A >= 2 teams AND (groupCount === 1 OR Group B >= 2 teams).

DELETE /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-fixtures deletes only league-stage gameweeks (`isPlayoffs = false`), cascading deletions to their fixtures and results; playoff GWs/fixtures are preserved. Returns `{ deletedGameweeks, deletedFixtures }` counts.
DELETE no-ops with HTTP 200 `No league-stage fixtures to delete` when no `isPlayoffs=false` GWs exist for the league.
All three generate-fixtures verbs (POST/GET/DELETE) invalidate the league page cache via `invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId)` on success.

bulk-upload-fixtures rejects requests with missing/non-array/empty `fixtures` array (HTTP 400 `No fixtures data provided`) and rejects >500 rows (HTTP 400 `Too many rows. Maximum 500 fixtures per upload.`).

bulk-upload-fixtures resolves teams by case-insensitive `teamLoginId` lookup; gameweek number must be 1..38; rows with missing fields, unknown teams, mismatched groups, or invalid GW are reported in `errors[]` and the row is skipped.
bulk-upload-fixtures rejects rows where homeTeam.groupId !== awayTeam.groupId; cross-group fixtures cannot be uploaded.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/bulk-upload-fixtures does NOT create missing gameweeks. Rows referencing a gameweek that doesn't exist for the league are appended to details.errors with the message 'GW<N> does not exist for this league. Run create-gameweeks first to populate real FPL deadlines.' This prevents synthetic `today + 7*N days` placeholder deadlines that would drift the schedule.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/bulk-upload-fixtures refuses (per-row error) any row whose gwNumber is in the playoff range (>= 31) when the league's playoffStartGw column is null. Prevents the `gwNumber >= null` always-false comparison from silently storing playoff-range fixtures as isPlayoffs=false. League-stage rows are unaffected.

bulk-upload-fixtures duplicate guard: if a fixture row for the same (gameweekId, homeTeamId, awayTeamId) already exists, the new row is rejected with `Fixture already exists` error; order matters (Home vs Away swap produces a different identity).

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/bulk-upload-fixtures with clearExisting=true deletes ONLY fixtures whose gameweekId belongs to a league-stage gameweek (gameweeks.isPlayoffs=false). Playoff fixtures generated by /api/admin/[leagueId]/generate-playoffs are preserved across a league-stage bulk re-upload. Mirrors the DELETE behaviour of /generate-fixtures.

bulk-upload-fixtures is annotated `@deprecated` (file header) — the Bulk Upload tab no longer exposes a Fixtures block; the unified Backup/Restore zip is the documented replacement. The endpoint remains for backwards compatibility.
GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] is a public route per middleware (matches `/^\/api\/gameweeks\/\d+$/` on GET) and does not require a session.
GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] validates gameweek number 1..38, returning HTTP 400 `Invalid gameweek number (must be 1-38)` for non-numeric or out-of-range values.
GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] accepts an optional `leagueId` query param accepting either a UUID or a league slug; non-UUID values are resolved to the league UUID via the slug lookup.
GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] returns 404 `Gameweek not found` when no row matches; with no `leagueId` it picks the first match across all leagues nondeterministically.

GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] response includes `gameweek.fixturesCount`, `gameweek.resultsProcessed` (count of fixtures with a result), `survivalCount` and `survivalRanked` (Challenger Survival entries scoped to that GW), plus arrays of `fixtures` (with `isChallenge`, `isPlayoff`, `result` if present) and `captains`.

POST /api/gameweeks/[gw] requires `x-session-type` of `admin` or `superadmin` (defense-in-depth on top of middleware); missing/wrong header returns HTTP 403 `Admin access required`. Middleware classifies POST as an admin-only route.

POST /api/gameweeks/[gw] supports `?force=true` to revert existing results, chip payouts, and team `leaguePoints`/`bonusPoints` (clamped at 0) before reprocessing; Double Pointer-doubled bonuses are correctly reverted as 2 pts and Challenge chip payouts are also rolled back.

POST /api/gameweeks/[gw] dispatches by league format: `continental-championship` -> processContinentalChampionshipGameweek, `auction` -> processAuctionGameweek, anything else -> in-route TVT scoring. The format dispatcher reads `leagues.format` for the resolved leagueId.

POST /api/gameweeks/[gw] REQUIRES a `leagueId` query parameter (accepts either a UUID or a league slug). Missing leagueId returns HTTP 400 `leagueId query parameter is required`; an unresolvable slug returns HTTP 404 `League not found`. The gameweek lookup is always scoped by both `gameweeks.number` and `gameweeks.leagueId`, and the format dispatcher reads `leagues.format` for the validated leagueId — eliminating nondeterministic cross-league GW selection and TVT-fallthrough for continental-championship/auction leagues.
TVT processing: only unprocessed fixtures (no result row) are scored; if all fixtures already have results, HTTP 200 `All fixtures already processed` with processed=0 is returned.

TVT processing builds a carry-forward hit map from GW(N-1) cached scores: any player whose `transferHits > 12` last GW has their full hits subtracted from their team's effective score this GW, with an audit log row of type `HIT_CARRY_FORWARD`.

TVT bonus point eligibility: a winning team with absolute score margin >= 75 in a group qualifies; per group, only the team(s) with the HIGHEST margin receives 1 bonus point (2 if Double Pointer chip used). Ties on highest margin all receive bonus.
TVT processing invalidates the league page cache (`invalidateLeaguePageCache`) at the end so standings/fixtures/playoffs pages reflect new results.
POST /api/admin/process-all/plan is superadmin-only via `isSuperAdmin(request)`; returns HTTP 403 `Superadmin only` otherwise. `maxDuration = 30s`.

computePlan() writes a CRON_RUN_START audit row, fetches FPL bootstrap once, and includes a GW in `dueGws` only if (a) the deadline has passed, (b) the GW has fixtures, and (c) the FPL bootstrap reports `finished === true` for that event id.
computePlan() returns active leagues only (`leagues.isActive = true`); inactive leagues are excluded from the orchestrator's loop.
POST /api/admin/process-all/league-gw is superadmin-only with `maxDuration = 60s`; body requires `league` (LeaguePlanItem) and `gw` (number); invalid JSON returns HTTP 400.
process-all/league-gw is on the expensive-route bucket (label `process-all-gw`): per-admin 30 POSTs/min rate limit applies.

processOneLeagueOneGw runs three steps in order: (1) score (auction-format uses processAuctionGameweek, others call the in-process POST handler with x-session-type=superadmin headers), (2) generate (only if `getPlayoffGenerateAction` returns a hit for this league/GW), (3) advance (only if GW falls in the playoff advance window and `hasAdvanceWork` returns true).

processOneLeagueOneGw clears live cache for the GW at the start of each call (non-fatal on failure) and writes a per-GW auto-snapshot tagged `gw{N}-auto` if scoring succeeded or was skipped without errors.
POST /api/admin/process-all/finish is superadmin-only with `maxDuration = 60s`; body requires `runId`, `dueGws` (array), `results` (array); missing fields return HTTP 400.

finishRun() detects the live GW via `detectLiveGameweek()` and populates the live cache for it if it falls in 31..38, then writes a CRON_RUN_END audit row with rolled-up summary (description trimmed to 1900 chars).
GET /api/fixtures is public (matches PUBLIC_ROUTES). Returns HTTP 400 `leagueSlug parameter is required` if missing; HTTP 404 `League not found` if slug doesn't resolve.

GET /api/fixtures returns `getCachedFixtures(leagueId)` directly when no `gameweek`/`group` filter is set and cache is warm; cache miss/Redis error falls through to DB. Writes the response back to cache (fire-and-forget) for future unfiltered hits.
GET /api/fixtures scopes the fixtures query to the league via `inArray(fixtures.gameweekId, leagueGwIds)`; if the league has zero GWs the result is empty (no DB call).

GET /api/fixtures sorts by GW number then group name and groups fixtures by gameweek number; response includes `totalFixtures`, `fixtures` (keyed by GW number), `playoffStartGw`, and `format`. On unknown errors a safe `{ fixtures: {}, playoffStartGw: 31 }` is returned instead of HTTP 500.
GET /api/fixtures filters: `?gameweek=N` filters in memory to matching gw number; `?group=A|B` filters in memory to matching group name; any other group value is ignored (no filter applied).
GET /api/fixtures/live requires `?gameweek=N` (HTTP 400 if missing) and 1..38 (HTTP 400 invalid otherwise); resolves `leagueSlug` to leagueId for scoped lookups.
GET /api/fixtures/live returns `{ isLive: false, fixtures: [] }` if no GW row exists, no fixtures exist, or the deadline has NOT passed (`reason: 'deadline_not_passed'`).
GET /api/fixtures/live returns stored result data (`isLive: false`, `reason: 'already_processed'`) when EVERY fixture in the GW has a result row.

GET /api/fixtures/live consults the 10-minute Redis live cache via `getLiveCachedScores`; on cache miss it falls back to DB partial results, then to a fresh FPL fetch which is written back to cache for 10 minutes.

GET /api/fixtures/live live-score computation: for each TVT team it sums per-player FPL net scores (fplScore - transferHits) and doubles the captain's contribution. If no captain row exists or the row was auto-assigned (`isValid === false`), `pickTempCaptain` selects the lowest-scoring player as temp captain and the response flags `isTempCaptain: true`.

GET /api/fixtures/live/refresh always fetches fresh from FPL (no cache read) and returns the new data; it does NOT write back to the 10-minute live cache, so the cache stays whatever `getLiveCachedScores` had.

GET /api/fixtures/live/refresh shares the same per-player TVT computation as /live but uses `fetchLiveGameweek` to map element ids -> live stats and respects captain `multiplier` rules (vice captain takes over with the captain's multiplier when captain didn't play).

defects.title: JPL Continental Championship fixture generation hardcodes 2 repetitions and assumes exactly 20 teams
defects.description: The JPL Continental Championship path in generate-fixtures uses `const tcRepetitions = 2;` and only validates `plTeams.length >= 2`. The summary message states '20-team, 1 PL group' but the code never enforces 20. defects.title: bulk-upload-fixtures synthesizes wrong deadlines and mis-classifies playoff GWs when playoffStartGw is null
defects.description: bulk-upload-fixtures creates missing gameweeks with `deadline = today + 7*N days` at 11:00 (not real FPL deadlines) and computes `isPlayoffs: gwNumber >= playoffStartGw`. If `playoffStartGw` is null in league config, `gwNumber >= null` is always false in JS, so playoff-range GWs (e.g. 31-38) are inserted as `isPlayoffs: false`. Downstream playoff generators and cron windows depend on `isPlayoffs` to scope their queries.
defects.expectedBehaviour: (a) Either reject the upload if league has no gameweeks (require create-gameweeks first) or fetch FPL bootstrap to seed real deadlines. (b) Reject the upload if `playoffStartGw` is null, or default it to 31 (matching effectivePlayoffStart elsewhere).
defects.actualBehaviour: Silent data corruption: synthetic deadlines bleed into live-mode + cron logic, and playoff GWs get the wrong `isPlayoffs` flag when league config is incomplete.

defects.title: POST /api/gameweeks/[gw] without leagueId falls through to TVT default and can score the wrong league
defects.description: When the POST handler receives no `leagueId` query param, the format lookup runs `eq(leagues.id, leagueId || '')` which never matches a real row; `leagueRow[0]?.format` becomes undefined and the route falls through to the TVT path. Meanwhile the gameweek lookup uses `eq(gameweeks.number, gameweekNumber)` (no league filter) and `gwList[0]` picks whichever league's GW happens to be first. The net effect: an unscoped POST can score the wrong league's TVT GW (or run TVT scoring against a continental-championship/auction league's data).
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either require a `leagueId` query param (return HTTP 400 if missing) or read the leagueId off the gameweek row found and re-dispatch by that league's format.
defects.actualBehaviour: Unscoped calls bypass format dispatch and process a nondeterministic league's GW.
defects.notes: Process-all orchestrator always passes leagueId, so the in-prod path is safe. Risk is direct admin POSTs or future tooling that forgets the query. The GET handler has the same nondeterminism (BR-GWFIX-035) but is read-only so the impact is lower. The gameweek `where` clause now always filters by both `gameweeks.number` and `gameweeks.leagueId`, and the format dispatcher uses the validated leagueId directly (removed the `leagueId || ''` fallbacks that masked the bug).
